name: Gitignore + Manual Post Tracker — prevent MP4 bloat + enable Apr 7 gate measurement
goal: Fix .gitignore to exclude generated pipeline artifacts (run dirs with MP4s, failure-library JSONs, skill-bank flywheel JSONs, ledger/experiments auto-updates). Build manual-post-tracker CLI so operator can record manually posted TikTok videos + view counts, enabling Apr 7 Phase 1.5 gate measurement without the TikTok API.
rationale: workspace/scs001/run-*/ directories contain generated MP4 files that must never be committed. Currently untracked. Also: TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN not set means posts must be manual — need a tracker to count real posts/views for Apr 7 kill switch decision.
swarm: NOT USED — .gitignore edit + new small script, writing directly.

tasks.title: .gitignore — add generated pipeline artifact patterns
tasks.description: Add to .gitignore: workspace/scs001/run-*/, data/failure-library/*.json, skill-bank/kognai-owned/content-flywheel/*.json, workspace/scs001/experiments.jsonl, workspace/scs001/publish-ledger.jsonl, workspace/scs001/viral-topics.json. These are runtime-generated files that should not be committed.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/record-manual-post.ts — manual post tracker CLI
tasks.description: CLI script: npx ts-node scripts/scs001/record-manual-post.ts --video-id <id> --views <n> [--title <str>]. Appends to workspace/scs001/manual-posts.jsonl. Shows running total: X/30 posts, total views, avg views/post. If views >= 500 total: print GATE STATUS: ON TRACK. Also support --list flag to display all recorded posts.

tasks.title: Validate — gitignore works + manual post tracker records correctly
tasks.description: git status should show fewer untracked files (run dirs ignored). Run record-manual-post.ts --video-id test-001 --views 150 and verify manual-posts.jsonl has the entry. Run --list. PASS = both work.
